# QYL0703: Consider configuring sampling

## Description

High-volume services can generate excessive telemetry data without sampling configuration. AlwaysOnSampler captures every span, which may overwhelm backends and increase costs. Consider using ParentBasedSampler (respects parent decisions) or TraceIdRatioBasedSampler (probabilistic) for production environments. Tail-based sampling at the collector level is also recommended for capturing important traces like errors.
